topic: Exact recurrences, reduced generating functions and one-defect transfer identities for horizontal-and-diagonal three-colour strips
title: Proof of Hardin's width-six three-colour one-defect recurrence

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We prove the empirical order-eighteen recurrence in R. H. Hardin's OEIS entry A229532, Formula field, revision 8 of 27 April 2021, for canonical three-colour n by 6 arrays with exactly one monochromatic horizontal, diagonal or antidiagonal bond, for every n >= 20. A 42-state transfer gives a finite integer certificate for all heights. The reduced rational generating function has minimal eventual order eighteen and discrepancy +864 at height nineteen. Seven smaller-strip recurrences and their sum-two variants follow from exact transfer identities. A general coefficient-extraction formula explains squared-denominator bounds.
summary: The width-six proof is supplemented by seven smaller-strip recurrences, credited empirical generating functions, the A269033 sum-two equivalence and at-most-one variants, boundary counts, and a general resolvent identity.
posing_locator: OEIS A229532, revision 8 (27 April 2021), Formula field, line 8; submitted by R. H. Hardin on 25 September 2013 (Author field, line 17)
